name: Acceptance
overview: Scripture teaches that acceptance begins with trusting God's provision and care, as Jesus encourages us not to worry about our lives or needs (Matthew 6:25). Christ assures that all who come to Him will never be rejected (John 6:37), modeling perfect acceptance. Believers are called to extend this same grace by receiving one another as Christ received us (Romans 15:7), embodying mercy, kindness, humility, and patience (Colossians 3:12). This divine acceptance challenges us to avoid judgment of others (Matthew 7:1) and to embrace both self-acceptance and acceptance of others within the body of Christ.
